prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, redesign, sign_in, reorder, finish, or new_flow changes, as no test showed a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Spotlight Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a spotlight layout with interactive sound previews and play buttons for each pet option. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and takes 89s median; giving clear audio and visual focus helps users pick quickly.)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Activity Log on Waiting Screen: Display dynamic wait status info with a progress indicator and asset loading steps on the waiting screen. (why: Home step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while users wait without feedback.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync Pet Safety Hint on Sign-In: Display a prominent security hint on the sign_in screen assuring users that signing in backs up their pet state to the cloud. (why: 8 support tickets last week reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [finish, incentive] First Habit Stamp Badge on Finish: Add a welcome badge and festive completion mascot to the home_intro screen celebrating successful adoption. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with an overall onboarding completion rate of only 17.8%.)
4: [sign_in, redesign] Split Layout Authentication Redesign: Redesign the sign_in screen to a split layout showcasing an animated pet companion preview alongside sign-in buttons. (why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users and has a mean duration of 567s.)
5: [home, notification] Background Loading Ready Notification: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen when long asset generation finishes. (why: Home waiting screen takes a mean of 2336s, causing users to switch windows and abandon the app.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Instant Start Story Screen Copy Optimization: Streamline story screen headline and body copy to convey the charm of desktop pets in one quick sentence. (why: Choose path screen takes a mean time of 514s; shortening intro copy reduces initial reading fatigue.)

scores.note: Adoption loses ~39% of users, but redesign tests show weak evidence (+1.7% noise-corrected) and high UI cost.
Home step has extreme mean duration (2336s); loading indicator reduces perceived wait without major redesign.
Strongest evidence combination (funnel drop + 8 support tickets); cheap copy/hint update.
Finish step drops 35%, but previous finish/new_flow changes showed negative results (-1.7%).
Sign-in loses 27% of users, but heavy redesign costs high effort with unproven track record (+0.7% measured).
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) by allowing out-of-app notifications for completion.
Low cost copy tweak targeting high mean time (514s) at the start of the funnel.
